edits.headline: Chilean exchange Orionx shuts down after $7m custody gap
edits.subheadline: A forensic audit found customer balances exceeded the assets the Tether-backed exchange held, Cointelegraph reported.
editorialBody: Orionx, a Chilean crypto exchange, said it was closing permanently and suspended withdrawals after a forensic audit found customer balances exceeded the assets held at its custody addresses, Cointelegraph reported. More than $7 million in customer assets had been moved to wallets the exchange did not manage. Tether led Orionx's Series A funding round in June 2025.
Floods in Nepal had killed at least 1,114 people and left 3,916 missing by 2 September, the country's disaster authority said, according to AFP.

The SEC's rewrite of its crypto custody rules entered White House review, The Defiant reported. Revolut began rolling out its EURR euro stablecoin, with Bridge as the regulated issuer, according to The Defiant.
